sources.title: UMPI current official Master of Arts in Organizational Leadership academic map
sources.scope: The live official map identifies all twelve OLS courses, their three domains, 36 total credits, and YourPace delivery. It does not identify a catalog edition or print a per-course credit column.

sources.title: University of Maine System Board academic affairs materials: UMPI MAOL proposal, October 2019
sources.location: Section IV.A, printed page 9 / PDF page 129
sources.scope: Dated original MAOL program proposal expressly assigns three credits to each of twelve competencies. Its twelve titles and three domains were crosschecked against the current official academic map; no current catalog edition is inferred from this historical document.

sources.title: UMPI current YourPace Master of Arts in Organizational Leadership program, admissions, graduate transfer policy and pricing
sources.scope: MAOL YourPace only. Six appropriate accredited graduate credits with B or better may transfer. The page supplies a $2,450 session rate and current graduate admission requirements, rather than an undergraduate ACE allowance or a guaranteed degree total.

sources.title: UMPI current YourPace FAQ: graduate degree total, session length and assessment proficiency
sources.scope: The graduate-specific answer confirms 36 credits. YourPace sessions last eight weeks and the final assessment minimum is 80. Undergraduate 30/12/9 residency language is not applied to this master's.
